thinking: Now let me run the generator, then validate and repair.Good, JSON is valid. Now let me run repair and validate.The validator gave WARNings about presentation text. These are about `title` fields inside the note objects that use `{"var": "global.formTitle"}`. The issue is that in the `saveNote` function, when creating or updating a note, the `title` field uses `{"var": "global.formTitle"}` which is

a JsonLogic expression, not a string.

However, this warning is about the data stored in the `notes` array, not about UI presentation text. The `title` field in the note object is data that gets displayed later via `{{ loop.item.title }}`. So when the note is stored, it should be stored with the actual string value, not a JsonLogic expression.

But wait - the way `@set` works with `push` or `map`

, the value gets evaluated at the time of the action. So `{"var": "global.formTitle"}` would be resolved to the actual string value when the action executes. The resulting stored note would have the actual string, not the JsonLogic expression.

The validator is just warning about JsonLogic being used in a field that is semantically a "presentation text" slot. But in this case it's data storage, no
